Name: HyperDrive
Description: Control HyperDrive, the stream helper for fighting game tournaments: scores, Display Controls, Crew/Team Battle, stage strike and bracket focus, with live state on the keys.

com.voidscape.hyperdrive.score.Name: Team Score
com.voidscape.hyperdrive.score.Tooltip: Adds a point to a team (hold to take one). Shows the team's score and color.

com.voidscape.hyperdrive.reset.Name: Reset Scoreboard
com.voidscape.hyperdrive.reset.Tooltip: Resets the scores, the match, the players or everything. Hold to reset.

com.voidscape.hyperdrive.team-color.Name: Team Color
com.voidscape.hyperdrive.team-color.Tooltip: Sets a team's color. Lit while the team has it.

com.voidscape.hyperdrive.load-set.Name: Load Set
com.voidscape.hyperdrive.load-set.Tooltip: Loads the next set of the stream queue, the set on stream, or opens the set selector.

com.voidscape.hyperdrive.display.Name: Display Controls
com.voidscape.hyperdrive.display.Tooltip: Shows, hides or toggles a layout folder, a group or everything. Lit while shown.

com.voidscape.hyperdrive.battle-score.Name: Team Battle Score
com.voidscape.hyperdrive.battle-score.Tooltip: A team scores in the Crew/Team Battle (hold to undo). Shows the active player.

com.voidscape.hyperdrive.battle-player.Name: Team Battle Player
com.voidscape.hyperdrive.battle-player.Tooltip: Makes the team's next player, or a given player, the active one.

com.voidscape.hyperdrive.battle-reset.Name: Team Battle Reset
com.voidscape.hyperdrive.battle-reset.Tooltip: Resets every player's stocks, or the whole battle. Hold to reset.

com.voidscape.hyperdrive.stage-strike.Name: Stage Strike
com.voidscape.hyperdrive.stage-strike.Tooltip: Undo, redo or restart the stage strike, or report the rock-paper-scissors or game winner.

com.voidscape.hyperdrive.bracket-focus.Name: Bracket Focus
com.voidscape.hyperdrive.bracket-focus.Tooltip: What the bracket focus layout shows: the whole bracket, a round, the set on a scoreboard, a tour or a player's run.
